x: The unorganised (informal) sector runs mostly on cash: its units are small, unregistered and outside the banking system, so it is marked by more currency transactions. Barter is marginal in today's economy (WBCS 2017 key gave 'more barter transactions').
source: Economic Survey 2016-17 Vol.1 ch.3 (informal sector is cash-intensive; demonetisation impact), indiabudget.gov.in
evidence: NextGen Indian Economy Part 1 - APPSC 04 (Drive 1DcaLfDlbZ7mxn8BRqHfeFyFrxOgehimd) p.30 (informal economy not taxed or monitored)
dispute: The WBCS official key gives 'more barter transactions'. Strictly, India's unorganised sector runs mostly on cash, so 'more currency transactions' is the factual description.
